description: This file declares the Timer and TimerFactory classes, which implement timer functionality including creation, cancellation, and activity status checks. It defines interfaces and classes related to timers within the firebolt::rialto::common namespace, including external dependencies and licensing information.

classes.name: TimerFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating Timer instances, implementing the ITimerFactory interface.

classes.name: Timer
classes.description: Implementation of the ITimer interface, managing timer lifecycle including start, cancel, and status.

methods.name: createTimer
methods.description: Creates a new Timer object with specified timeout, callback, and timer type.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Checks if the timer is currently active.
